headline: Marvell agrees to buy Lumentum for $115 billion
summary: Marvell has agreed to acquire optical component maker Lumentum for $115 billion in an all-stock deal, combining Marvell's networking and photonics silicon with Lumentum's lasers and transceivers. Outlets note Nvidia is a shared strategic investor in both companies, with optics demand expected to grow as AI systems scale up.
